mech_summary: Soul items generate a resource (Souls) on enemy kill; the Corrupted Beacon artifact consumes Souls to fire a sustained high-damage beam, making it the loop anchor — the build IS 'gather Souls, fire Beacon.' Harvester provides AoE Soul-burst; Souldancer Robe / Soul Robe amplify gather rate. Zero skill tree: gear+enchant IS the entire build.

mech_summary: Fireworks Arrow artifact fires an explosive chain that hits everything in proximity; paired with Scatter Crossbow or Winter's Touch each shot triggers a separate firework explosion, creating multiplicative AoE chain damage. The artifact IS the loop — cooldown reduction (via armor enchants and Refreshment) cycles it back fast enough to sustain AoE artillery. Enchantment-stacking on armor reduces artifact cooldown; this IS the MCD support-gem-grammar cousin: enchant slots play the role of support gem links, each reducing recharge to keep the loop live.

tempo.note: rapid cooldown cycling with enchant stack

amp.note: each explosion is burst damage; 9 fireworks per Winter's Touch trigger

commit.note: artifact fires on button — no wind-up; cooldown is the gating constraint

geo.note: explosion chain hits large packs; Winter's Touch = 9 simultaneous detonations

econ.note: enchant stacking on armor/weapon reduces artifact recharge — support-gem-grammar cousin (GX-portability §9.16 evidence)

mech_summary: Dynamo enchantment stacks damage bonuses with each consecutive roll (up to 20×); the loop is ROLL to stack Dynamo, then ATTACK to unload — every roll resets the rhythm. Torment Quiver fires soul-seeking arrows between rolls, sustaining soul generation. The community knows two variants: Standstill (rooted, maximizes stack accumulation) and Rolling (mobile, continuous partial stacks). This is an enchantment-as-loop-engine: Dynamo IS the archetype identity, the weapon is the delivery vehicle.

range.note: primarily ranged (torment arrow) with melee roll loop

tempo.note: roll-rhythm cadence — high tempo rolls, single release strike

amp.note: 20× Dynamo stack = extreme burst ceiling; wiki notes 540M+ damage potential with full combos

commit.note: each roll is the 'wind-up'; the attack is the payload — roll commitment IS the build; GX-03 apply-then-consume family

geo.note: torment arrow seeks one target; Dynamo burst on single target

def.note: wiki notes Potion Barrier provides near-constant DR in endgame variants

econ.note: roll stacks → single release — closest MCD exhibit to a charge-spend econ loop

mob.note: rolling IS the build mechanic — movement and damage generation are fused

mech_summary: Evocation Robe / Ember Robe provides native artifact cooldown reduction (-30–40%), enabling the Boots of Swiftness movement artifact to cycle near-permanently; combined with high-attack-speed daggers/sickles and the Light Feather for dash-cancels, the robe IS the loop anchor — cooldown makes the speed cycle self-sustaining. Community names it 'Speedy Steve' (Gamepur) or 'Speedy Assassin' (GamingScan). Convergent folk name across ≥4 guides; the ROBE is the item-defined loop anchor (the robe's cooldown reduction rate defines whether the mobility loop is closed or open).

tempo.note: the entire build maximizes attack speed and movement speed simultaneously

amp.note: no burst ceiling; relies on high hit-count with on-hit procs (Radiance, Critical Hit)

def.note: mobility IS defense; constant movement avoids most damage

econ.note: robe cooldown reduction IS the loop closure; without the robe the speed loop is open (artifacts expire faster than they refill)

mob.note: GX-01 exhibit: the Boots of Swiftness IS the movement verb and IS the build identity — speed is not incidental

mech_summary: Three artifact slots fill with companion summons — Golem Kit (iron golem), Tasty Bone (wolf), Wonderful Wheat (llama) — so ALL three artifact slots ARE the damage source; player provides target selection and healing totem. The companions ARE the kit. Hunter's Promise bow directs companions to marked targets. Zero skill tree: the artifact loadout IS the build identity. This is G13 (enemy-roster-as-arsenal) flipped — player summons ARE the arsenal. Community calls it Beast Master or Companion build; convergent folk name.

range.note: player uses bow to mark/direct; companions do the melee work

tempo.note: companions attack autonomously; player cadence is low

amp.note: companion damage is sustained flat output; no burst ceiling
